policy.rule: Novel paper semantics stay downstream. Generic runtime, evidence, recovery, evaluation and reproducibility mechanisms move upstream only after real reproduction pressure justifies them.

platform_gaps.problem: Long-running methods need an auditable model-facing context projection that never mutates durable host truth, preserves tool-call/result atomicity, and fails closed on irrecoverable overflow.

Agent Turn VM must record exact model-visible inputs, decisions, actions, observations and tool-effect identities as typed ordered machine facts committed through the existing Kernel Journal. Checkpoints may reference a journal cursor/head digest for recovery, but must not become a second trajectory authority.
A growing paper program needs a machine-verifiable inventory that maps external methods to Noetrium-owned runtime authorities without turning research intelligence into another runtime subsystem.
Long-running agent methods require resumable, idempotent progress across extended tool/environment execution without duplicating per-paper checkpoint logic.

Independent memory and tool-use methods require semantic retrieval over authoritative source references. The reusable layer is a rebuildable derived projection plus read-only query contract; it never owns source truth, capability schemas, memory movement, paper-specific scoring or tool-search policy.

Independent self-evolving methods generate or revise executable capabilities. Candidate identity, isolated execution, permissions, effect evidence, lineage and rollback must be reusable Platform mechanisms while mutation/search/selection semantics remain method-owned.

Independent multi-agent methods require attributable participant/message identities, explicit sender/receiver or broadcast topology, ordered or round-scoped causal facts, artifact/message lineage and replayable human interruption. Speaker selection, debate exchange, role-playing, society behavior and SOP policies remain method-owned.

innovation_tracks.scientific_boundary: SEM owns Typed Memory DAG, evidence-grounded memory evolution, Meta-Architect decisions and trusted evolution semantics; Noetrium owns generic runtime, model, environment, evidence, experiment, checkpoint and evaluation infrastructure.
Explore constrained search over memory architecture and evolution operators while keeping execution, provenance, evaluation and recovery platform-owned.
Explore online scaffold adaptation under immutable evidence and rollback constraints, with self-modification semantics downstream and isolation/recovery upstream.

project_constraints.reason: Voyager may be reproduced as an isolated external baseline, but its skill/curriculum machinery must not alter SEM scientific behavior.
